ip: the sciences concerned with gathering, manipulating, storing, retrieving, and classifying recorded information
ipo: a corporation's first offer to sell stock to the public
ipv: a poliovirus vaccine consisting of inactivated polio virus that is injected subcutaneously to provide immunity to poliomyelitis
ipad: a table computer from Apple Inc
iphone: a smartphone designed and marketed by Apple Inc.
ipod: (trademark) a pocket-sized device used to play music files
ipecac: a medicinal drug used to evoke vomiting (especially in cases of drug overdose or poisoning)
iproclozide: an antidepressant drug that acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor
ipsilateral: on or relating to the same side (of the body)
